registryProposal: deployment-contract's golden path opens 'A repository that deploys through a hosting platform', but in this repo it bites hardest on PRODUCT-mediated deployments (the app shipping a user's persona to a cloud runtime / GitLab Duo): deploy-gate-coupling already absorbed one such lesson (the 'verify the address production serves, not a local twin' rule), and environment-promotion's rollback-is-re-pointing caught a second here. The golden path should say whether an application that deploys its users' artifacts to a host is in scope, so judges stop deciding it by analogy pair by pair.
